episodes.title: The Night the Forest Burned
episodes.main_beat: Ember sees lightning after the first flames; finds a luminous blue feather in ashes.

episodes.title: Nobody Believed the Fox
episodes.main_beat: The council blames Ember and exiles him; a hidden call guides him to Luma.
episodes.ending: An owl knows Ember by name.

episodes.title: The Owl's Secret
episodes.main_beat: Luma reveals the signal alarm rang before the storm; someone silenced it.
episodes.ending: The missing bell rope was cut.

episodes.title: Footprints in the Rain
episodes.main_beat: Ember follows wet tracks toward the forbidden river and finds a torn map.
episodes.ending: Wolf tracks end at a locked gate.

episodes.title: The Wolf Who Helped
episodes.main_beat: Ash saves Ember from the water but secretly pockets the rest of the map.
episodes.ending: Ember sees the matching torn edge.

episodes.title: The Empty Nest
episodes.main_beat: Luma vanishes while investigating; Moss finds her compass in a nest.
episodes.ending: The compass points beneath the dam.

episodes.title: The River of Lies
episodes.main_beat: Ember decodes the compass and uncovers evidence the old dam warning failed.
episodes.ending: Scratching sounds come from behind a wall.

episodes.title: The Buried Gate
episodes.main_beat: They find animals stranded behind an old spillway and a sabotaged gate lever.

episodes.title: A Friend's Betrayal
episodes.main_beat: Ash confesses his family hid the broken warning system to avoid blame.
episodes.ending: A new flood is racing toward the gate.

episodes.title: The Last Crossing
episodes.main_beat: The team opens the channel while Ember risks being swept away.

episodes.title: Who Started the Fire?
episodes.main_beat: Luma and Moss rescue Ember; evidence shows an unattended faulty signal lantern sparked the fire; the storm followed.
episodes.ending: Will the forest believe evidence over fear?

episodes.title: The Forest Remembers
episodes.main_beat: Ash and his family confess; animals rebuild and honor Ember; the full central conflict ends.
episodes.ending: Finale: peaceful sunrise; no compulsory unresolved cliffhanger.
